name: Rendang
description: Beef cooked in coconut milk and spice paste for hours until the liquid is gone and the meat fries in its own oil.

ayurveda.note: Ushna in a high degree — chilli, galangal and lemongrass.

unani.note: Garam-khushk; it is dry by the end.

histamine.note: Hours of cooking on meat, plus chilli — and rendang is deliberately kept for days, which was its purpose.

nutrition.highlight: cooked until the liquid is gone
